QuestInfo.name: Beyond the Hermitage
QuestInfo.0: You don't intend to really, honestly help him, but it might not be a bad idea to at least feign to lend a hand for now.
QuestInfo.1: Before speaking with the Taotie to leave, you should make sure you're adequately prepared. There should be some things in one of your Master's cabinets that could prove helpful on your journey.
QuestInfo.2: After getting everything you thought you might need, you left the hermitage with dreams of fame and fortune in the outside world.
